scope: 'riichi' decisions (riichi legal, no opponent riichi): dama / break per legal discard plus riichi per tenpai-keeping discard
network: score(option) = w2 . h_L + b2, h_1 = relu(W1 @ concat((x - mean) / std, onehot(state), (sit - sit_mean) / sit_std) + b1), h_(i+1) = relu(Wh[i-1] @ h_i + bh[i-1]), L = 3; softmax over the decision's options
labels: teacher policy over the options; riichi options share the teacher riichi prob (log-sum-exp), split by the declaring-discard policy where scored
fitted_on: single-kyoku games: teacher RLActor-225 vs tsumogiri x3 (60,000) and current suzume (kan_mode=1) vs tsumogiri x3 (15,000), teacher labels; riichi adds the riichi-only scoring of 52,472 current-suzume games
split: md5(game) % 10: 0 test (report only), 1-2 valid (early stopping), 3-9 train
optimizer: schedulefree.RAdamScheduleFree lr 0.01, other settings at library defaults (decoupled weight decay; eval-mode weights kept)

curve.rule: keep the eval-mode weights of the lowest valid CE over the whole run (improvement > 1e-5); train at least min_epochs; after that stop only when valid CE has been worse than the best so far by more than worse_tol for `patience` consecutive epochs; at most max_epochs
